name: Shanghai Yaohua Pilkington Glass Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Yaohua Pilkington Glass Group Co., Ltd. engages in the production and sale of glass in China and internationally. It provides float glass, including clear and low iron glass, on line coated, special function, green tinted, privacy grey tinted, TCO glass, online energy saving, photovoltaic, grey tinted, industrial float glass, and aviation glass substrates. The company also offers architectural processing glass, such as energy-saving, composition, technical protection against glass, special application, decorative, and power generation glass; automotive glazing glass comprising ordinary and rail transit vehicle, and sky glass assembly system; home appliance glass; and special glass. …
